title: 第19章 我没有道德第20章 道骨异动
content_zh:
第19章我没有道德远风城内，还有很多少年，没有展现他们的风采。
可是，还有上场的必要吗？
见证了萧沉刚才的战斗，就算他们上场，还也无人感兴趣了吧。
一人而已，压盖了远风城所有人的光芒。
可他们心里对萧沉也没有怨恨，只有仰望。
那是，连先天道体都能跨境界击败的人，也许，整个祁国，都难有人能企及。
“今日大比，到此为止吧。”
凌远图似乎也看懂了众人的眼神，淡漠地开口宣布道。
没有名次，没有结果，就此结束。
人群怅然若失，却又回味无穷，今日精彩的战斗，远风城前所未有。
“敢问城主，矿脉，该由哪一家族掌管？”
萧沉望向凌远图，朗声问道。
霎那间，一股锐利的目光刺落在萧沉身上，凌远图很不情愿，但还是冷声开口了。
“今后一年，矿脉交由白家掌管！”
“多谢城主。”
萧沉看着拂袖而去的凌远图，高声回应道。
白家众人都笑了，在此之前，谁能想到，周家先天道体横空出世，他们白家还能夺得矿脉归属权。
“眼光不错。”
白清风笑着对白念冰说道，使得白念冰俏脸又红了起来。
和白家的兴奋形成强烈对比的是周狂昭，他的神情极冷，起身正准备离开，却听得一道冰冷的声音从背后传来。

“老狗，你想就这么离开吗？”
回过身，周狂昭看到少年坚毅而冷峻的眼神，他突然意识到，眼前这个少年，早已不再是他可以轻易拿捏掌控的傀儡了。
“糟糕！”
周狂昭心中暗道，王家老者只想着带走周凌雪，却忘了他也是萧沉想要杀的人。
“你想怎么样？”
周狂昭冷漠问道。
“用你的血，祭奠我的双亲。”
萧沉的口中吐出一道肃杀的声音，人群心头皆颤，王家的玄府境强者离开，周狂昭，能挡得住萧沉的复仇吗？
“我对你兄妹二人有养育之恩。”
周狂昭神色难看，他没有拿王家来压萧沉，因为他知道，萧沉根本不在乎！
“可你未曾有半点真心。”
萧沉打断了他的话，“我双亲被你害死，此仇不共戴天！”
轰！
萧沉身上气息狂暴，苦海咆哮，战王拳怒轰而出，天地元气宛若排山倒海般扫荡向周狂昭。
“大逆不道！”
周狂昭双掌齐出，苦海九重的真元力量轰然爆发，他的掌力若九重叠浪，不断增强，拍打向前。
不少离去之人停下了脚步，望向这里的战斗。
“周狂昭好歹也是一家之主，应该没那么好对付吧？”
有人暗想。
然而，萧沉拳威所向，周狂昭的掌力竟如土鸡瓦狗般骤然崩灭，恐怖的拳威冲击而来，竟让这位叱咤远风城多年的周家之主倒飞了出去！
content_en:
Chapter 19 I have no morals. There are many young people in Yuanfeng City who have not shown their grace.
But is it still necessary to play?
After witnessing Xiao Chen's battle just now, even if they came on stage, no one would be interested.
Just one person, overwhelming the light of everyone in Yuanfeng City.
But they had no resentment towards Xiao Chen, they only looked up to him.
That is, even the person who can defeat the innate Taoist body across realms, perhaps, it is difficult for anyone in the entire Qi Kingdom to match it.
"That's it for today's competition."
Ling Yuantu seemed to understand everyone's eyes and announced indifferently.
No ranking, no results, it’s over.
The crowd felt disappointed, but they had endless aftertaste. Today's exciting battle was unprecedented in Far Wind City.
"May I ask the city lord, which family should be in charge of the mine?"
Xiao Chen looked at Ling Yuantu and asked loudly.
Suddenly, a sharp gaze fell on Xiao Chen. Ling Yuantu was very reluctant, but he still spoke coldly.
"In the next one year, the mine will be under the control of the Bai family!"
"Thank you City Lord."
Xiao Chen looked at Ling Yuantu who was walking away and responded loudly.
Everyone in the Bai family laughed. Before this, who would have thought that with the Zhou family's innate Taoist body emerging, the Bai family would be able to seize ownership of the mineral veins.
"Good taste."
Bai Qingfeng said to Bai Nianbing with a smile, making Bai Nianbing's pretty face turn red again.
In sharp contrast to the excitement of the Bai family, Zhou Kuangzhao had a very cold expression. He stood up and was about to leave when he heard a cold voice coming from behind.
"Old dog, do you want to leave like this?"
Turning around, Zhou Kuangzhao saw the young man's resolute and stern eyes, and he suddenly realized that the young man in front of him was no longer a puppet that he could easily control.
"Oops!"
Zhou Kuangzhao secretly thought that the old man of the Wang family only wanted to take Zhou Lingxue away, but he forgot that he was also the person Xiao Chen wanted to kill.
"What do you want?"
Zhou Kuangzhao asked indifferently.
"Use your blood to honor my parents."
A chilling sound came out of Xiao Chen's mouth, and the crowd's hearts trembled. With the Wang family's Xuanfu realm powerhouse leaving, could Zhou Kuangzhao be able to stop Xiao Chen's revenge?
"I have a nurturing grace for your brother and sister."
Zhou Kuangzhao looked ugly. He didn't use the Wang family to pressure Xiao Chen, because he knew that Xiao Chen didn't care at all!
"But you have never been sincere."
Xiao Chen interrupted him, "My parents were killed by you, and this hatred is irreconcilable!"
Boom!
The aura on Xiao Chen's body was violent, the sea of ​​bitterness roared, the King of War Fist roared out, and the vitality of heaven and earth swept towards Zhou Kuangzhao like an overwhelming force.
"Treasonous!"
Zhou Kuangzhao thrust out both palms, and the true energy power of the ninth level of the Sea of Bitterness exploded. The power of his palms was like nine overlapping waves, which continued to strengthen and slapped forward.
Many people who left stopped and looked at the battle here.
"Zhou Kuangzhao is also the head of the family after all, so he shouldn't be that easy to deal with, right?"
someone thought to himself.
However, when Xiao Chen's fist was directed towards him, Zhou Kuangzhao's palm power suddenly collapsed like a chicken or a dog. The terrifying impact of the fist made the head of the Zhou family, who had dominated the Wind City for many years, fly backwards!
